title: dev-prune Project Configuration Schema
description: Per-repository configuration schema for dev-prune workspace cleaner.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference URL for IDE autocomplete and validation.

_note.description: Informational note for developers. Run `devp config . --update` to validate and sync configuration settings.

project_name.description: Custom display name for this project in TUI tables and CLI status views.

ignore.description: Set to true to ignore/exclude this repository from all dev-prune cleanup passes.

disable_hooks.description: Set to true to disable global Git background auto-registration hooks for this specific workspace.

disable_daemon.description: Set to true to disable background daemon automated pruning for this specific workspace.

override_idle_days.description: Custom inactivity threshold in days for this specific repository. Overrides global settings.

custom_bloat_dirs.description: List of additional build artifact directory names to clean in this repository (e.g. ['dist', '.cache', 'out']).

post_prune_command.description: Optional shell command or script to execute after a successful prune pass in this workspace.
